comparison.objective: Brace a rolling rack and slide a loaded sheet pan into its second slot; candidate removes insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual bracing and guided slot insertion versus stabilizing a mandrel under hammer impact and recovering fractured fragments.
comparison.success_condition: Pan inserted, rack translation under 40 mm with no turn, and one-second stable hold; other hazard thresholds are unspecified. Candidate requires four contained fractures and undamaged retained inserts.
comparison.reason: Bracing is shared only generically; guided insertion into a rack is materially different from controlled fracture and debris accounting.
